$schema: Optional starting ATS slugs for the emergent company index. EMPTY by default -- Jobe ships no curated company list (any such list is arbitrary and field-biased). The index grows automatically from slug-harvest (role-less Brave queries against ATS domains) and from query-driven aggregator results, so employers in your field surface over time. To seed it directly, add slugs: { "greenhouse": ["slug"], "lever": ["slug"], "ashby": ["slug"] }.
